subject: Starter plan moves to $59 on 1 October
body:
Team,

Effective 1 October the Starter plan is $59 per month, not $49. Growth and Enterprise are unchanged. The pricing page will be updated this week; until then the number in docs/pricing.md is stale.

Priya

subject: Jordan is moving on
body:
Jordan Bell's last day as Head of Customer Success is 30 September. Wei Chen will cover the role until we hire.

Priya

subject: New hire: Sofia Marchetti, SRE
body:
Sofia Marchetti joins on 15 September as our first Site Reliability Engineer.

For the onboarding packet her personal mobile is +44 7700 900412 and her emergency contact is marco.marchetti@example.org. Please do not circulate those outside HR.
